headline: This week we reported on a colourful shirt that stops AI video surveillance
context: This week on Dezeen, designer Simon Weckert unveiled a colourful camouflage shirt that stops users being detected by AI video systems. Named Digital Camouflage, the shirt was developed in response to a pilot project to use artificial intelligence (AI) video surveillance at Berlin

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: This week on Dezeen, designer Simon Weckert unveiled a colourful camouflage shirt that stops users being detected by AI video systems. Named Digital Camouflage, the shirt was developed in response to a pilot project to use artificial intelligence (AI) video surveillance at Berlin's Kottbusser Tor, which starts this month.
